roomConcept: THE PROPERTY KIT — the component standard of the "Inherited Premises" design language. Doctrine: there are no widgets, only props. Every component is a physical object with three declared facts before it ships — WHAT it is (object test), what it RESTS ON (every prop names a host surface: blotter, cork, sheet, wall, rail), and what MADE ITS MARKS (source test: typewriter, sign painter, rubber stamp, pencil, press). Components ship in flat material colors with zero private gradients, glows, or elevation shadows; the room's single light rig (one pointer-events:none overlay stack per room) lights them. Two planes, one law: environment props take unlimited seeded wear; document props hold decision data typed at full contrast, 0° rotation, tabular — jitter the decoration, never the data. Amber is lamplight, never ink or fill; state changes are physical (a check moves, a stamp lands, a key leaves a hook) and land within 400ms of their cause. Radius is 0 everywhere. Disabled is dusty, never grayed, and always says why in type. Interaction cost never exceeds the widget replaced; every count removed from chrome survives as visible evidence plus an aria-label. If you cannot buy, type, paint, stamp, or tape a component in 1975, it does not enter this library.

objectMap.object: PLAQUE BUTTON (`<PlaqueButton variant="steel"|"brass">`): painted-steel plaque or engraved brass plate screwed to its host surface. 0 radius, flat material fill (--locker-steel / --brass-polished band), stamped bevel — hard 1px light edge top-left, 1px dark edge bottom-right — four seeded screwhead dots (radial-gradient, rust-bled where --gym-age is high), label in Anton caps or Libre Franklin engraving. Heavy fixtures (punch clock, tear-off pad) are one-off compositions of the same material tokens, not variants.
objectMap.behavior: Hover: the specular gradient stop brightens/shifts 2px (lamp catch — background-position, never a glow or color fill). Active: travels 1px down-right into its own shadow, bevel inverts (--ease-steel where animated; the 1px travel itself is reduced-motion-safe). Disabled: dust film (soft-light gray pseudo, duller specular), NEVER opacity-grayed, with the reason typed beside it in form print; cursor not-allowed. Focus: brass glint ring (see entry 16). All targets ≥44px. Deletes: gradient pill body, 0.12em tracking, translateY hover, 0 0 N glow shadows.
objectMap.rationale: A screwed plaque is the only thing a 1975 gym had that is permanent, labeled, and pressable; the 1px travel plus inverted bevel is exactly what pressed metal does under a thumb, and 'dusty' reads as 'nobody uses this' where gray reads as software.

objectMap.element: SECONDARY ACTION — `.btn--ghost`, `.arrival__btn`, `.fp-news__btn`, inline text actions ('Decide later', 'View later', 'Take down')
objectMap.object: TYPED CHIT (`<PaperAction>`): a printed line, tear-off chit, or small slip ON the host paper — boxed Libre Franklin label or typed Special Elite line, ink ≥4.5:1 on its stock. The paper it sits on is its entire chrome: no fill, no border-radius, no standalone rectangle floating on the dark plane.
objectMap.behavior: Hover: corner curls 2–3px (transform on a ::after corner pseudo, never the text) or a fingertip-smudge band. Active: the physical thing happens — chit tears off, slip slides to the tray, corner flips — ≤260ms --ease-paper with 0.5–2° rotation (paper never travels straight). Disabled: dusty with typed reason ('NO ROOM'). Reduced-motion: snap to end state. Focus: brass glint ring. Secondary-ness is encoded by material (paper is cheaper than steel), not by lower contrast.
objectMap.rationale: The steel/paper split teaches commitment weight through material: permanent acts are hardware, transactional acts are paperwork — the hierarchy the old primary/ghost variants faked with opacity.

objectMap.element: DESTRUCTIVE ACTION — 'CUT FROM THE GYM', walk-in 'Turn him away', fireCoach 'Let go', 'Stop considering'
objectMap.object: STAMP ACTION (`<StampAction>`): a red rubber stamp applied to the victim's paper — 'RELEASED', 'NOT FOR US', 'PASSED ON' in Anton caps through the shared SVG erosion filter, ink --ink-stamp-red, fixed −2° category angle, seeded ±1° wobble.
objectMap.behavior: Two-phase confirm kept everywhere: first press draws a red grease-pencil strike through the line plus a faint stamp pre-impression and a typed full-contrast 'STRIKE FROM ROSTER? — CONFIRM / CANCEL' line; confirm slams the stamp (--ease-stamp, 90–120ms accelerating IN, impact never eases out) and the paper files out ≤400ms (exit-before-unmount, off-left or to the drawer); cancel erases the strike leaving a permanent faint smudge (seeded). Hover: lamp glints on the handle — no lift. Disabled: dusty + typed reason. Reduced-motion: instant ink, instant removal. Both phases ≥44px, labeled, focusable.
objectMap.rationale: Cutting a man must cost a small violent gesture and leave evidence; ink that accelerates in and never bounces back is the physics of irreversibility, and the leftover smudge means the gym remembers your changed mind.

objectMap.element: TAB / DIVIDER — FighterProfile tab strip, `.rivals__scope-btn`, and (divergence resolved) `.office__tabs`, `.press__tabs`, LockerRoom view switcher
objectMap.object: FOLDER TAB (`<FolderTab>`): die-cut manila divider — clip-path trapezoid, 0 radius, staggered seeded widths, typed Special Elite label, one dog-eared tab per set (seeded). RESOLUTION: FolderTab is canonical ONLY where the fiction is one divided document (fighter folder, rivals dossier). Where 'tabs' actually switch between different physical things — office desk objects, paper vs. magazine on the bench, wall/clipboard/book in the locker room — the pattern is OBJECT PICK-UP (each destination is its own prop, entered via `<PaperSurface>`); rendering FolderTab there is a spec violation.
objectMap.behavior: Active tab pulled 2px forward, casting one hard shadow on the tab behind (shared shadow direction of the room); switching sheets is a 180ms paper lift-and-drop, never a crossfade. Disabled divider (lockerless Development): dusty, its sheet edge visibly absent from the stack, title tooltip kept. Real button semantics in a tablist, arrow keys move, focus = brass glint. Reduced-motion: instant swap.
objectMap.rationale: A divided dossier is what 1975 filing actually was; restricting the component to real documents is what keeps it from becoming a skinned segment control worn by everything.

objectMap.element: SELECT / DROPDOWN — native `<select>` in `.frow__focus-select`, `.fp__focus-select` (×2), MyGym posting select; all option-pill groups
objectMap.object: PRINTED CHECKLIST (`<Checklist>`, ≤7 options) / TRAINING-ORDERS CARD (`<OrdersCard>`, >7): the checklist is pre-printed Libre Franklin lines with square ruled boxes and one graphite pencil check (SVG stroke, seeded wobble), inline on the host paper, all options always visible. The orders card is an index-card popover ('CARD 7-A REV. 9/74') that slides up from the bottom third as an object you pick up.
objectMap.behavior: Click a line: the check erases (permanent ghost smudge stays at the old line, seeded) and stamps in at the new one (90ms), result typed onto the host line ≤400ms. Real radiogroup: arrows move, space checks, every line ≥44px. OrdersCard: Esc puts it down WITHOUT closing the parent (layered Esc preserved); choosing files the card away (260ms --ease-paper). Disabled lines: printed reason ('ALL SLOTS FILLED — SEE HOOK BOARD'), dusty. Native <select> is deleted game-wide immediately.
objectMap.rationale: The checklist beats the dropdown it replaces — zero open-click, all options scannable — while being exactly the form a gym office would mimeograph; the ghost smudge gives every assignment a memory.

objectMap.element: LIST ROW — `.qrow` (office queue), LockerRoom `.frow` roster rows, `.bench__man`, MyGym focused rows, applicant letters
objectMap.object: ROSTER LINE (`<RosterLine>`): one typed line on the host sheet — paperclipped snapshot thumbnail at seeded ≤2° skew, name in Special Elite caps, second line in Courier Prime tabular ('AGE 24 · WELTERWEIGHT · 41 DAYS') at exactly 0°, inline InkStamps and pencil marginalia; printed rules from the sheet run beneath (Libre Franklin form print).
objectMap.behavior: Hover: fingertip-smudge highlight — a soft multiply darkening band across the line — never a glow, never levitation. The whole line is one ≥44px target (opens profile / deals the slip up). Enter/exit: paper deal-in and file-out with --ease-paper. Data-plane law on the line: no stain, tape, or grain may cross the type; the photo and marginalia may jitter, the columns may not. Focus: brass glint on the line.
objectMap.rationale: Every list in the building becomes something somebody typed, so scanning a roster is reading a page — the period-true fast read — and a smudge is what a finger actually leaves on paper.

objectMap.element: DATA TABLE — `.bookrow` ledger history, Development view grid, `.rankrow` ratings rows, Record-tab cells, finances lines
objectMap.object: LEDGER GRID (`<LedgerGrid>`): pre-printed ruled grid — repeating-linear-gradient rules in --index-rule (blue) or graphite, column heads in Libre Franklin 500 12px, figures in Courier Prime tabular, right-aligned. Variants: ACCOUNTS (income in --ink-ballpoint, outgoings in red ink, redundant with +/− signs and accountancy parens; net under a true double rule), RATINGS (leader dots from name to record), PROGRESS (light-blue graph grid under grease-pencil traces).
objectMap.behavior: Figures at exactly 0° rotation, 7:1 contrast, aligned down the page for vertical comparison; no grain, stain, or lighting hot-spot may reduce a numeral below 7:1. Row hover exists only where a row is a link (smudge). Scrolls inside its page mask (entry 15). Most-recent-row emphasis is fresher ink on the CONTAINER stock, never opacity on values. Mobile column-drop behavior preserved.
objectMap.rationale: Courier's natural tabularity plus printed rules is a strictly better scanning instrument than the flexbox rows it replaces, and double-entry red-and-blue is the one semantic color 1975 already owned.

objectMap.element: DIALOG / FORM — `.wiv` + `.wiv__scrim`, FighterProfile role=dialog panel, `.arrival` centered modal, lease packet, all confirms
objectMap.object: PAPER SURFACE (`<PaperSurface stock rest>`): every dialog is a document dealt onto a named resting surface — blotter, bench, cork, clipboard — with that surface always visible at the frame edges. Stock prop picks the paper token (index-card, manila, memo-pink, newsprint); the centered modal, scrim, rounded corners, and elevation shadow are deleted, not restyled.
objectMap.behavior: Enter: slides up from the bottom third and settles with seeded 0.5–2° rotation (--ease-paper, 240–320ms). Exit-before-unmount: files away by verdict (right to the locker, left off the desk, down into tray/drawer), ≤400ms. Esc ALWAYS puts the object down, top layer first (existing viewerIds guard preserved). Lit by the room rig: one multiply lamp gradient with one hot corner — the paper is lit, never luminous. role=dialog, focus trap, and aria labels kept. Reduced-motion: snap in/out.
objectMap.rationale: Nothing may float in a void: a document that lands on a desk and gets filed by your verdict turns every interruption into a thing that physically happened in the room.

objectMap.element: NOTIFICATION / NOTE — ArrivalNotice plain mode (`.arrival__*`), poach notices, mid-week event notes
objectMap.object: MEMO SLIP (`<MemoSlip>`): the pink 'WHILE YOU WERE OUT' slip — --memo-pink stock, Libre Franklin pre-printed header and rules, events typed in Special Elite ≥14px, counts typed as numerals; poached men annotated in ballpoint ('— signed w/ St. Nicholas', --ink-ballpoint). One slip object everywhere in the game: under the floor door, on the blotter, clipped to the Monday paper.
objectMap.behavior: Lands with seeded ≤2° settle rotation; role=alert kept. Actions are physical and one click each: pull the clipped walk-in cards (View Now), slide to the wire tray (View Later — the tray visibly keeps the slip, tally in its aria-label), impale on the desk spindle (Noted — the spike stack grows over the save's life). Tone escalation = wording + a second slip stacked, never hue alone. Reduced-motion: appear/dismiss instantly.
objectMap.rationale: The CD names this exact object; a phone-message slip is how news reached a 1975 office, and the spike quietly archiving your dismissals turns notification hygiene into world memory.

objectMap.element: CHIP / BADGE / STAMP — MoodChip `.mood--*`, TraitChip `.trait-chip`, tier/status chips, LIMITED/LOCKER tags, all pills and count badges
objectMap.object: INK STAMP (`<InkStamp category>`): a rubber-stamp mark — Anton caps through ONE shared feTurbulence erosion filter def (mounted once at app root), fixed ink and angle per CATEGORY: mood --ink-ribbon blue-black at 0°, trajectory --ink-stamp-red at −2°, scouting/feel green-gray (#5c6355) at +1.5°, admin --ink-stamp-violet at 0°; seeded ±1° per-instance wobble. Border shape is part of the code: single frame, double frame, or bare underline per category.
objectMap.behavior: Static ink — no hover state (paper doesn't react to eyes); blurbs live in title/aria. Meaning is carried by word + border shape + position, never hue alone; a stamp never solely carries a stat, price, or deadline, and never touches a numeral column. Landing a new stamp uses --ease-stamp (90ms) at the moment it is caused. All pill radii, tinted fills, currentColor borders, and the red pulse badge are deleted; counts route to TallyProp (entry 12).
objectMap.rationale: Fixed angle and ink per category makes stamps pre-attentively scannable down a roster like a real trainer's marks, while the eroded edge and wobble keep them ink instead of icons.

objectMap.element: METER / GAUGE — AttributeBar `.attr__track/__fill`, `.attr--band` scouting bands, trend arrows `.attr__trend--up/--down` (with #7bbf6a), Sparkline traces
objectMap.object: PENCIL SCALE (`<PencilScale>`): typed Courier Prime numeral FIRST, then a flat-ended grease-pencil stroke of exactly proportional length across a pre-printed ruled 0–100 scale (Libre Franklin scale print). Trend = two penciled ticks plus a pencil word ('coming on' / 'slipping'). BAND variant (lockerless): no numeral — a feathered graphite hatch smear over the believed range plus the typed band word; unknown = bare rule and a pencil '?'. Sparklines become grease-pencil traces on graph grid.
objectMap.behavior: Numerals tabular, 0°, 7:1 after the light layer. Stroke length animates ONCE on data change (--ease-paper), no ambient animation ever. Hover: fingertip smudge on the row reveals the penciled margin annotation ('+1.2 recent · +4.1 since he arrived'), also kept in title. Hatch may jitter; the numeral and band word may not. Direction is encoded by slope/tick shape + word, never color alone; #7bbf6a is deleted.
objectMap.rationale: Numeral-first keeps the read as fast as the bar it replaces, and a grease stroke on a printed scale is literally what a 1975 trainer did to a chart — the meter passes both the object and source tests.

objectMap.element: COUNT EVIDENCE — walk-in pulse badge, roster count '8', locker/focus progress bars, tab-label counts '(3)', staff tallies
objectMap.object: TALLY PROP (`<TallyProp>`): the count rendered as countable objects — pink slips under a door, brass keys on a numbered rack, envelopes on a bill spike, manila tags on hooks, chalk tallies on a slate — always paired with a typed tally card ('3 WAITING' / '8 LOCKERS — 3 ASSIGNED') in Courier/Franklin at full contrast, and the exact figure in the control's aria-label.
objectMap.behavior: Every change adds or removes ONE object within 400ms of its cause (--ease-paper for paper, --ease-steel for keys, damped pin-swing for tags); the typed card retypes in place, no tween. Zero state: the bare prop (empty hooks, tape ghost, wiped slate) plus a typed 'NOBODY WAITING'. Never a badge, dot, meter, or KPI strip. Reduced-motion: objects appear/disappear instantly. The prop is usually also the click target into its detail (≥44px).
objectMap.rationale: Principle 6 verbatim: three men waiting rendered as three pieces of paper someone shoved under a door is pre-attentive, honest, and needs no legend — the pulse animation becomes an event that physically occurred.

objectMap.object: BARE SURFACE + PENCIL NOTE: emptiness is the host object visibly unoccupied — an empty wire tray on bare blotter, blank printed form lines, doors standing ajar and dark, sun-faded rectangles and old pin holes on cork, a blank ruled ledger page — plus at most one Caveat pencil line ≥14px in the trainer's voice ('nobody today. keep the lights on — word spreads.').
objectMap.behavior: Static; the pencil note doubles as the guidance click target where one exists (e.g. '→ pick 'em in the locker room' → openRoom). The container's aria-label announces the state ('No applicants yet'). Never centered italic prose, never an illustration, never a dimmed clone of the filled state. The newspaper is the one exception: it never runs empty — slow weeks print a 'QUIET WEEK' brief padded with a period house ad.
objectMap.rationale: Unused paper and vacated cork say 'nothing here, and here is the proof' the way a placeholder paragraph can't — and the wear marks say something WAS here once, which is world-building for free.

objectMap.element: TOAST / FLASH — Toast.tsx `.toast` (bottom-center floating italic panel)
objectMap.object: FLASH SLIP: a transient MemoSlip variant pinned to the nearest real surface — the corkboard's edge on the Floor, the blotter margin inside rooms — typed Special Elite ≥14px on --memo-pink or scrap newsprint, seeded ≤2° tilt, one pushpin.
objectMap.behavior: Pins on with a damped pin-swing (paper settle on blotter), holds its timeout, then files itself out (exit-before-unmount, --ease-paper); hover pauses the timer — touch, not glow (the pin catches the lamp). role=status retained; stacking flashes queue vertically down the board edge, newest on top. Reduced-motion: instant in/out, full-duration hold. The centered, glowing, bottom-floating toast is deleted.
objectMap.rationale: A note somebody just pinned up is the only 1975-true 'transient message'; anchoring it to a surface the player already knows keeps flash messages inside the room instead of on top of the game.

objectMap.element: SCROLL SURFACE — global `::-webkit-scrollbar` (rounded, amber-hover), `.logboard__list`, `.fp-news` overflow, ledger/book/page scrolling
objectMap.object: PAGE MASK: scrolling always happens INSIDE a document or drawer — within the ledger page, the folder sheet, the newspaper — never on the viewport (body overflow:hidden stands). Continuation is signaled physically: a bottom-edge page-curl shadow, an agate 'cont'd on next page' line on newsprint, ledger rules running off the mask.
objectMap.behavior: Scrollbar restyled flat: 10px steel track (--locker-steel at 40%), square 0-radius thumb in --brass-oxidized, hover to --brass-polished (a glint, ≥3:1 non-text contrast) — border-radius and amber-glow hover deleted. scrollbar-color set for Firefox. Native momentum, keyboard scrolling, and scroll-into-view preserved; masks use overflow-y:auto with overscroll-behavior:contain so a page never scrolls the room behind it.
objectMap.rationale: Paper has edges, not fades; keeping scroll inside the fiction's documents means the room never moves when you read, which is what makes the room feel like architecture.

objectMap.object: BRASS GLINT RING: the retained 2px solid outline recolored to --brass-polished #c9a55c at 2px offset, plus a small specular glint pseudo at the ring's top-light corner (matching the room's shadow direction) — reading as lamplight catching a brass edge, not a browser adornment.
objectMap.behavior: Lives once in global.css on :focus-visible and MAY NOT be removed, thinned, or replaced by box-shadow in any component restyle (guardrail). ≥3:1 non-text contrast verified on both planes: brass on leather-black ≈8:1, on index-card ≈1.9:1 — so on paper stocks the ring auto-swaps to --ink-ribbon via a .on-paper scope (still 2px, still offset). Follows clip-path silhouettes where supported (outline on the shaped element), rect fallback otherwise. Esc semantics ride with it: whatever holds focus can always be 'put down'.
objectMap.rationale: Focus is the one legally emissive-looking mark the game needs constantly; casting it as brass under lamplight keeps keyboard players first-class without a single SaaS pixel.

layout: Seeded-asymmetry tokens, all deterministic from entity id (hash → CSS custom props at render): --rot-paper: −2°…+2° (documents, slips, photos); --rot-dressing: −3°…+3° (set dressing only); --rot-stamp: category angle ±1°; --drift-x/--drift-y: 0–6px placement drift; --fan-step: 2–4px edge offset per sheet in stacks. Density: typed line-height 1.35–1.45; roster lines 44–52px tall; ledger rows 24–28px; sheet padding asymmetric (left margin ≥ right by a seeded 4–10px, like real typing). The grid may NOT be broken at: numeric/data columns (exactly 0°, tabular, aligned), printed form rules and their fill lines, checklist rows, ratings tables, baseline of any compared text, 44px hit targets, and the room's single shadow direction. Random-per-mount jitter is banned; a re-render must reproduce the identical scene.
materialsAndLight: Texture kit — baked SVG feTurbulence data-URI tiles, defined once as tokens (--tex-paper, --tex-cork, --tex-steel, --tex-plaster, --tex-canvas; each ≤8KB, tiling 240–480px). PAPER: stock color + --tex-paper at 4–6% multiply + one multiply lamp gradient (one hot corner); rules via repeating-linear-gradient; torn/deckled edges via static clip-path polygons. CORK: --tobacco base + dense speckle tile (two turbulence octaves) soft-light + seeded pin holes/faded rectangles. STEEL: --locker-steel vertical gradient with one narrow specular stop + scratch tile at 5%, hard 1px bevels. OAK: repeating-linear-gradient grain (7–13px bands) + low-frequency tile multiply. BRASS: --brass-oxidized→--brass-polished two-stop with tight bright band; glint = ::after white streak ≤12% opacity. TAPE: rgba(217,211,194,.85), darker edge lines, 1px shadow beneath. CHALK: near-white ink + 0.5px blur + noise mask. Layer order: base → tile → seeded wear → content → room light rig (soft-light key pool, screen shafts, multiply darkness; max two blend layers/room, pointer-events:none). Live filters only in one-time static defs (stamps, pencil strokes); never on elements that animate or scroll.
typography: By SOURCE, never hierarchy. POSTER/SIGN: Anton 400 — headlines, painted signs, stamps; 20–72px, tracking 0–0.02em, caps; ink-bleed via 1px same-hue text-shadow. Ultra 400 — fat-face display (title, magazine nameplate) only, ≥32px. TYPEWRITER: Special Elite 400 — worn field paperwork; 14–16px, one weight, no italics (emphasis = underline/CAPS/x-strike), seeded word-level 88–100% ribbon opacity (flavor text only). Courier Prime 400/700 — machine output: ledgers, records, tallies; 13–15px, tabular-nums, 0 tracking. FORM PRINT: Libre Franklin 500 — pre-printed labels, rules, form numbers; 12–14px, tracking ≤0.03em, caps. HAND: Caveat 400/600 — pencil marginalia, ≥14px, one-read flavor only; Permanent Marker 400 — tape labels, 14–18px. NEWSPRINT: Noticia Text 400/700 — justified, hyphenated body, 14px; UnifrakturMaguntia 400 — masthead word only. Stacks: Anton→'Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif; Ultra→'Bookman Old Style',serif; Special Elite/Courier Prime→'Courier New',monospace; Libre Franklin→'Franklin Gothic Medium',Arial,sans-serif; Caveat→'Segoe Script',cursive; Permanent Marker→'Segoe Print',cursive; Noticia→Georgia,serif; Unifraktur→'Old English Text MT',serif. Deleted: Big Shoulders Display, Oswald, Roboto Slab. Nine self-hosted subsetted woff2, ~160KB, font-display:swap.
imperfections: Wear tokens (all seeded by entity id, scaled by --gym-age, margins only, never over type or numerals): --seed-rot / --seed-drift consumed by .p-tilt; .p-stain (coffee ring radial, ~1 sheet in 4, margin-clipped); .p-dogear (folded-corner clip-path + shadow triangle, one per tab/sheet set); .p-tape / .p-tape-ghost (fresh tape vs. residue rectangle); .p-clip-rust (bleed under paperclips/staples); .s-screws (four seeded screwheads on steel); .s-rust-seam (hinge/handle water runs, ~30% of steel); .s-smudge (hand-height darkening at latches); .eraser-ghost (permanent after any changed choice); .sun-fade (rectangle where paper hung). No two instances identical; unseeded wear is omitted, never randomized.
immersionRationale: PALETTE SPEC — every token names a material or ink; abstract tokens (--accent, --success) banned; #7bbf6a deleted. ENVIRONMENT: --ink-black #0c0907 (deep shadow, survives); leather ramp --leather-black #14100c / --leather-dark #1f1812 / --leather #2a1f15 / --leather-light #3a2a1c (floor darkness, blotter); --oak #7a5c38 (desk, bench); --tobacco #6f5136 (cork, aged trim); --locker-steel #5c635a / --locker-steel-lit #757c70 (doors, panels, scrollbar track); --plaster-mint #98a58e (upper walls); --gym-green #435243 (accounts-book cloth, wainscot); --concrete #8a8578 (block, thresholds); --brass-oxidized #8a7440 / --brass-polished #c9a55c (plates, keys, focus ring, scrollbar thumb); --paint-red-faded #8f4438 (ring apron, EXIT box, door lettering). PAPER STOCKS: --newsprint #d6d1c2; --pulp #d4b98a; --manila #cfae72; --index-card #ece2c8 with --index-rule #9fb0bd; --memo-pink #e3c1b4. INKS (never pure black): --ink-ribbon #33383e (typewriter — on index-card ≈9:1, passes 7:1 numerals; on manila ≈5.4:1, body-text pass); --ink-graphite #4a463f (pencil — on index ≈7:1, flavor ≥14px); --ink-stamp-red #8f3b2e (on index ≈5.8:1 word-pass; on manila ≈3.5:1 → stamps on manila are always redundant-encoded flavor, decision text on manila uses ribbon ink); --ink-stamp-violet #5c4a63 (on index ≈6.3:1); --ink-ballpoint #2f4468 (on index ≈7.6:1); --ink-news #2e2b26 (on newsprint ≈8.5:1); scouting green-gray #5c6355 (on index ≈5.5:1). LIGHT (overlay-only, never ink or fill): --lamp-amber #d99a4e ramp (#e8b566 hot / #8a5320 ember) for key pools, shafts, glints; --daylight tokens graded by season. Dark-plane pairings: --index-card signage on leather-black ≈14.6:1; --brass-polished on leather-black ≈8:1 (focus ring, non-text 3:1 pass). Lighting composite budget: multiply layers may darken paper ≤12%, so worst-case ribbon-on-index stays ≈7.3:1 — every decision numeral passes 7:1 AFTER the rig. Each material ships fresh/worn/old via color-mix() toward --concrete (fading) or --ink-black (grime), keyed to --gym-age.
implementationNotes: theme.css: KEEP --ink-black, leather ramp, spacing scale, --shadow-cast; RENAME amber ramp to --lamp-* and demote to light-rig-only (lint: amber may appear only in background-image of .rig layers); MAP --oxblood→--paint-red-faded/--ink-stamp-red; DELETE parchment trio (→ paper stocks), --gold-line, all --radius-* (radius is 0), --font-display/--font-condensed/--font-slab, --ease-warm (→ --ease-paper 180–260ms, --ease-steel 320–450ms, --ease-stamp 90–120ms, steps() for electric). global.css: keep reset, body overflow:hidden, reduced-motion snap; recolor focus ring per entry 16; replace .worn vignette with per-room rig; delete backdrop-filter in .timebar/.logboard; square the scrollbar. index.html: drop Google Fonts link; self-host nine subsets, preload Special Elite + Libre Franklin. Load order: tokens+texture data-URIs → global → room rigs → components. Mount stamp/pencil/erosion SVG defs once at app root; never filter animating elements. A11y: counts/paths in aria-labels, layered Esc preserved, checklists as real radiogroups, fixture flicker and silhouette loops gated behind prefers-reduced-motion; sessions run hundreds of advances, so zero permanent content-plane animation.
